ops.vehicleRules: Vehicles heading to the banquet lobby entrance use the access road beyond the main entrance, reached from Hibiya-dori. Vehicles going directly to the parking lot will find it convenient to enter via the driveway between the Main Building and the Tower. (Source: Parking page)
ops.parking: The parking lot has 425 spaces. Rates are 600 yen per 30 minutes, with a daily maximum of 12,000 yen (tax included). Vehicle limits are 2.1 m in height, 1.95 m in width and 6 m in length; vehicles with low ground clearance cannot use the lot. For banquet parking benefits, wedding receptions get free parking on the day only; for general banquets it varies by event, so check with the organizer or the hotel's banquet reservations desk. EV chargers are available for a fee.
ops.catering: For banquets, the hotel provides the food and drinks. There are plans with food by purpose, including the Cocktail Buffet Plan (20 to 100 guests, 2 hours, free-flow drinks included, from 15,000 yen per person, tax and service charge included, April 1, 2026 to March 31, 2027) and the Meeting Plan (5 to 20 guests: 150,000 yen for a 4F banquet room; 21 to 40 guests: 250,000 yen for a 3F banquet room; each 120 minutes, coffee and tea included, April 1, 2026 to March 31, 2027). Food allergies and dietary restrictions can be discussed when booking, and children's menus are available for a fee. Screens, projectors, simultaneous interpretation systems, microphones, and high-speed internet and Wi-Fi can be requested when booking.
ops.restaurants: According to the floor map, the Main Building has restaurants and bars (including lounges) on the 17th floor, 1st floor, basement 1 and mezzanine. For banquet guests, there are cloakrooms on the Main Lobby, Banquet Lobby and banquet room floors, men's and women's changing rooms on the Main Building 2F, and a smoking room next to the cloakroom on the 3F.
